tools.name: music
tools.description: Read or control what Apple Music or Spotify is playing on this Mac. action "status" reports the current track; play/pause/toggle/next/previous control playback; "volume" sets volume to value (0-100); "seek" jumps to value seconds; "favorite"/"unfavorite" add or remove the current Apple Music song from Favorites. "shuffle" toggles shuffle and "repeat" cycles repeat (off, all, one; Spotify has no one), or set them with mode ("on"/"off" for shuffle, "off"/"all"/"one" for repeat). "list_playlists" lists the user's Apple Music playlists; "play_playlist" plays one by name (partial names work). app defaults to whichever app is currently playing.
